title: Glowing fire truck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground hint -->
  <rect x='6' y='78' width='88' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#2b3a5a'/>
  <!-- hose reel / back body -->
  <rect x='12' y='40' width='48' height='34' rx='4' fill='#e8362f'/>
  <!-- body top highlight -->
  <rect x='14' y='42' width='44' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff6b5e'/>
  <!-- ladder rails -->
  <rect x='20' y='34' width='40' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <rect x='20' y='28' width='40' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#e0a92e'/>
  <!-- ladder rungs -->
  <rect x='26' y='30' width='3' height='9' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <rect x='36' y='30' width='3' height='9' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <rect x='46' y='30' width='3' height='9' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <!-- cab -->
  <path d='M60 74 V50 a4 4 0 0 1 4-4 h14 a5 5 0 0 1 4 2 l8 10 v16 a3 3 0 0 1-3 3 h-3 v-3 a3 3 0 0 0-6 0 v3 h-14 a3 3 0 0 1-3-3z' fill='#f2463e'/>
  <!-- cab window -->
  <path d='M66 51 h11 l7 9 h-18 z' fill='#7fe3ff'/>
  <!-- window shine -->
  <path d='M68 53 h6 l4 5 h-10 z' fill='#c9f5ff'/>
  <!-- white stripe -->
  <rect x='12' y='62' width='92' height='4' rx='1' fill='#f2f0e8' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- hose reel detail -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='58' r='8' fill='#b92a24'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ff9f96'/>
  <!-- lights bar -->
  <rect x='62' y='46' width='10' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='62' r='3' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='76' r='10' fill='#2c2c3a'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='76' r='10' fill='none' stroke='#5c6b8a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='76' r='4' fill='#aab6d0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='10' fill='#2c2c3a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='10' fill='none' stroke='#5c6b8a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='4' fill='#aab6d0'/>
  <!-- glow accent on body -->
  <rect x='16' y='45' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffb0a8'/>
</svg>
